poison.name: Poisoned
poison.detail: Loses {damage} HP per action ({turns} ticks left)
poison.desc: Settles on actions; the duration counts down in ticks.

bleed.name: Bleeding
bleed.detail: Loses {damage} HP per action ({turns} ticks left)
bleed.desc: Bleed damage scales with the attacker's ATK.

charge.name: Charging
charge.detail: Next action: a guaranteed massive strike
charge.desc: Charging takes one action; can be dispelled.

grudge.name: Grudge
grudge.desc: Hoarded on hits taken; no cap, decays over ticks.

guard.name: Forge Mark
guard.desc: Gained on hits taken; decays over ticks.

retribution.name: Ledger
retribution.desc: The next landed hit pays it back with interest.

regen.name: Renewal
regen.desc: The renewal mark slowly mends wounds.

lifesteal.name: Bloodthirst
lifesteal.desc: A share of damage dealt becomes HP.

will.name: Defiance
will.detail: Fatal blow: {value} chance to recover to {heal} HP
will.desc: The chance decays after each trigger.

tempo.name: Blooming
tempo.desc: Grows after each action, no cap.

blood_pact.name: Blood Pact
blood_pact.detail: Action start: chance to sacrifice - lifesteal {value}, convert {convert}
